Better
than if there were thousands
dhp101:1:
Better
than if there were thousands
dhp103:2:
Greater in battle
than the man who would conquer
a thousand-thousand men,
dhp103:3:
is he who would conquer
just one–
dhp105:2: nor a Mara banded with Brahmas,
dhp105:3:
could turn that triumph
back into defeat.
You could,
dhp106:2:
month by month,
at a cost of thousands,
conduct sacrifices
a hundred times,
dhp106:3:
or
pay a single moment’s homage
to one person,
self-cultivated.
dhp106:5:
Better than a hundred years of sacrifices
would that act of homage be.
dhp107:1:
You could, for a hundred years,
live in a forest
tending a fire,
dhp107:3:
or
pay a single moment’s homage
to one person,
self-cultivated.
dhp107:5:
Better than a hundred years of sacrifices
would that act of homage be.
dhp108:1:
Everything offered
or sacrificed in the world
dhp108:2: for an entire year by one seeking merit
dhp108:4:
Better to pay respect
to those who’ve gone
the straight way.
dhp110:1:
Better than a hundred years
lived without virtue, uncentered, is
one day
dhp110:2:
lived by a virtuous person
absorbed in jhana.
dhp111:1:
And better than a hundred years
lived undiscerning, uncentered, is
one day
dhp111:2:
lived by a discerning person
absorbed in jhana.
dhp112:1: And better than a hundred years
dhp112:2:
lived apathetic & unenergetic, is
one day
lived energetic & firm.
dhp113:1:
And better than a hundred years
lived without seeing
dhp113:4:
arising & passing away, is
one day
lived seeing
arising & passing away.
dhp114:1:
And better than a hundred years
lived without seeing
the Deathless state, is
one day
lived seeing
the Deathless state.
